evaluation_documents.text: The librarian placed a small green notebook beside the window. Inside it, visitors could write the title of a book they wanted to read. By Friday, every page contained a different suggestion.
A narrow path divided the garden into two sections. One side held vegetables, while the other was filled with flowers. Each evening, a neighbor watered the plants and checked the soil.
Before leaving for the village, Maya checked both tires on her bicycle. She packed a map, a bottle of water, and a light jacket. The road followed the river for several miles.
The recipe called for flour, milk, and three eggs. After mixing the ingredients, the cook poured the batter into a shallow pan. A warm breakfast soon filled the kitchen with a pleasant smell.
Beyond the city lights, the night sky looked unusually clear. A group of friends brought a telescope to the hillside. They took turns looking at the moon and writing down their observations.
In the workshop, a wooden box held screws of several sizes. The carpenter sorted them into separate trays before starting the repair. This small preparation made the rest of the work much easier.
